eli5.text: In Freebuff Desktop, you can normally run up to three tabs of the cheaper, unlimited models at once, but only one tab of the expensive ones at a time. A side note in the code admits that models which are both metered and multi-tab cannot be safely allowed yet, so that combination stays blocked until a separate safety check is upgraded. The fix is live today.

ai.summary: Added freebuffModelUnavailableWindow to derive refusal message from model availability. Fixes off_peak_only models quoting staffing hours instead of DeepSeek peak window return. Uses formatDeepSeekExpensiveWindowReturn for local time phrasing.

eli5.text: When you try to use a model that is closed during DeepSeek's peak pricing hours, you are now told the correct time it comes back instead of a generic staffing-hours message. Previously, models marked as off-peak-only would incorrectly tell you they were unavailable during our own support hours, even though they actually reopen after DeepSeek's peak window ends. You now see a clear local-time message like 'again at 7:00 PM' instead of a confusing range mixing two time zones. This fix is live today for anyone using free-tier or public-API sessions that hit these model restrictions.
